criteria.name: functional_correctness
criteria.description: Code handles specified requirements, edge cases, zero off-by-one errors, and passes unit tests.

criteria.name: security_and_injection_safety
criteria.description: Zero injection vectors, safe handling of input sanitization, and no hardcoded credentials.

criteria.name: maintainability_and_style
criteria.description: Clean modular functions, typed interfaces, and minimal safe diffs.
